limits: UI card counts are estimates and are not completeness evidence.
Historical ID coverage does not prove all current new IDs were exported.

Nullable text/JSON blank fields can lose NULL versus empty or JSON-null distinctions. No write is inferred from an ambiguous CSV field. Semantically unchanged means compatible, conditional on those ambiguities.
Target digest comparisons normalize ambiguous blanks as SQL NULL; they do not prove raw NULL/empty fidelity.
Target model is the verified import checkpoint, preserving the prior pipeline timestamp conflict and target-only cluster; it is not a new live target query.
The extra target-generated evidence audit row is intentionally outside the source snapshot model.
Files exported at different times are not an atomic database snapshot.
